items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Oh, well I think he's just in a class by himself.

ctx.x: Yeah, something different, you know? People were always very intrigued by women pianist. There's - but that's not who I meant though. There is another gal that was very big at the same time that made alot of records that Roy Melton and Camille (Howard) did. I can hear her voice right now. Well, never mind. If it doesn't come to you and it hasn't come to me. Well, there are just a couple of names I want to throw at you. One is Ray Charles.
Oh, well I think he's just in a class by himself.
